summary: Constructs a settings file path by copying the application directory string into a path buffer, then appending a base file path (asc_5CD148), a caller-supplied player-specific identifier (a2), and a file suffix (asc_5CD144). The completed path is passed to ShortComputation_1b70 for further processing, and its result returned.

operations.description: Copy the application directory string (byte_5EA438) into the path buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Append the base file path string asc_5CD148 to the buffer via sub_5665B0.
Append the caller-supplied player-specific identifier a2 to the buffer via sub_5665B0.
Append the file suffix string asc_5CD144 to the buffer via sub_5665B0.
Pass the built path buffer to ShortComputation_1b70 for processing.

unresolved: Identity of the player-specific identifier a2 and the exact meanings of the asc_5CD148 / asc_5CD144 path components.
What ShortComputation_1b70 does with the built path is outside this function's scope.
